products.title: Head Extreme Pro 2026 - Head
products.description:
HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 - We present the most powerful racket in the Extreme collection, a true attacking machine that stands out for its explosive punch and firmness in offensive hits. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 arrives with a diamond format and high balance, a configuration that favors power and allows you to make the most of the inertia of the racket. It concentrates greater inertia in the upper part, favoring shots and blows above the head.

PLAYER TYPE

If you are one of those who look for any opportunity to get up to the net and finish the point, this Extreme Pro has a lot to offer you. It is a padel racket with a clearly offensive character, one of those that brings out its best version when we play with determination and hit with good technique.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 stands out for its UD Carbon HS carbon construction that provides rigidity, while the Power Foam core provides a fast and energetic response. In addition, it incorporates the new Auxetic 2.0 technology to improve the sensations and connection with the ball in each impact.

It also incorporates Extreme Spin technology, a 3D roughness that facilitates spin, and Optimized Sweet Spot, which optimizes the distribution of the holes to improve the useful hitting area.

On the other hand, we continue with the Tailored Frame construction to help achieve a more consistent response, while the Soft Cap+ system improves grip comfort, reducing vibrations.

products.description:
HEAD GRAPHENE 360 VECTOR 2025 - One of Head's star rackets is back. A leading model in sales thanks to its versatility, good sensations and good price. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

One of the most anticipated Head racquets of this year is here. After last season's model was one of the best-selling padel rackets, this HEAD GRAPHENE 360 VECTOR 2025 arrives, a model that stands out for its versatility and feel, along with top-level materials.

PLAYER TYPE

Its comfort and characteristics mean that it can be adapted to all types of players, however, we recommend this HEAD GRAPHENE 360 VECTOR 2025 for advanced level players looking for a complete and good padel racket for the elbow.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

After a model that left us speechless last season, due to its performance and behavior on the court, comes this new Head racket wonder.

The HEAD GRAPHENE 360 VECTOR 2025 has an oversized hybrid design, a versatile format, which generates great results in attack and defense, and which, together with its enlarged sweet spot and its medium balance, achieves a very comfortable racket to use.

If we talk about the construction materials section we have to highlight its carbon fiber throughout the tubular frame and the Graphene 360 ​​material for the planes. This combination of materials allows the racket to be light, durable and resistant.

At the core of this Head racket it incorporates Comfort Foam rubber, a very comfortable rubber that reduces all vibrations and allows you to avoid elbow and shoulder injuries while maintaining a good ball output.

In the frames we have the integrated protector (Integrated Protector), a protector that is located inside the racket and that reinforces the frame against blows typical of the game.

It also has Tailored Frame technology, where each part of the padel racket is built independently, to improve its behavior and durability.

PLAY STYLE

The HEAD GRAPHENE 360 VECTOR 2025 is a very complete racket, so it can be adapted to different playing styles. The shovel will allow us to improve both offensively and defensively. So if we want a racket that helps us a little with everything, the Head Monster is the best option.

HEAD GRAPHENE 360 VECTOR 2025 - One of Head's star rackets is back. A leading model in sales thanks to its versatility, good sensations and good price. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

One of the most anticipated Head racquets of this year is here. After last season's model was one of the best-selling padel rackets, this HEAD GRAPHENE 360 VECTOR 2025 arrives, a model that stands out for its versatility and feel, along with top-level materials.

PLAYER TYPE

Its comfort and characteristics mean that it can be adapted to all types of players, however, we recommend this HEAD GRAPHENE 360 VECTOR 2025 for advanced level players looking for a complete and good padel racket for the elbow.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

After a model that left us speechless last season, due to its performance and behavior on the court, comes this new Head racket wonder.

The HEAD GRAPHENE 360 VECTOR 2025 has an oversized hybrid design, a versatile format, which generates great results in attack and defense, and which, together with its enlarged sweet spot and its medium balance, achieves a very comfortable racket to use.

If we talk about the construction materials section we have to highlight its carbon fiber throughout the tubular frame and the Graphene 360 ​​material for the planes. This combination of materials allows the racket to be light, durable and resistant.

At the core of this Head racket it incorporates Comfort Foam rubber, a very comfortable rubber that reduces all vibrations and allows you to avoid elbow and shoulder injuries while maintaining a good ball output.

In the frames we have the integrated protector (Integrated Protector), a protector that is located inside the racket and that reinforces the frame against blows typical of the game.

It also has Tailored Frame technology, where each part of the padel racket is built independently, to improve its behavior and durability.

PLAY STYLE

The HEAD GRAPHENE 360 VECTOR 2025 is a very complete racket, so it can be adapted to different playing styles. The shovel will allow us to improve both offensively and defensively. So if we want a racket that helps us a little with everything, the Head Monster is the best option.

products.title: Dunlop Fx Team 2026 - Dunlop
products.description:
DUNLOP FX TEAM 2026 - Perfect for intermediate or even advanced players. An offensive racket, since the FX series stands out for it.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The DUNLOP FX TEAM 2026 is a padel racket designed to offer us a perfect balance between power, control and precision. It is the most versatile model in the FX series. With a beautiful design in gray and blue, in a diamond format that will offer us high balance.

PLAYER TYPE

Ideal for players looking for versatile and constant performance on each point. Its diamond format is perfect for intermediate or advanced backhand players.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

Its structure incorporates Force Bridge technology in the bridge, which provides greater stability when hitting, allowing more powerful hits.

At the core, it has Pro EVA rubber, a foam that offers a firm but reactive touch. On the other hand, thanks to SpinBoost, the grip on the ball is increased, facilitating the generation of spin to dominate with topspin or sliced ​​shots.

One of the most effective technologies of this racket is the Power Holes, based on the strategic distribution of the holes, it expands the sweet spot and provides greater precision in hitting.

products.title: Black Crown Hurricane Pro 4.0 - Black Crown
products.description:
BLACK CROWN HURRICANE PRO 4.0 - Llega la nueva Hurricane, una de las palas Black Crown más deseadas cada temporada sin lugar a dudas. Versión 4.0 con la firma de Marta Marrero. INTRODUCCIÓN DE LA PALA

La BLACK CROWN HURRICANE PRO 4.0 llega bastante renovada y nos parece una pala especialmente interesante para el jugador avanzado que quiere tener mucho control, pero necesita que la pala responda cuando toca acelerar. Aunque tiene formato redondo, no estamos ante una pala puramente defensiva: tiene carácter, un tacto firme y potencia suficiente para terminar los puntos desde la red.

TIPO DE JUGADOR

Este modelo lo recomendamos para jugadores experimentados de alto nivel que quieran una pala profesional para rendir al máximo.

CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA PALA

En los planos encontramos Carbono 12K Power, que le da ese golpeo firme y preciso que esperamos de una pala de nivel alto. Cuando golpeamos fuerte, responde muy bien y transmite bastante seguridad, algo que nos gusta especialmente en voleas, bandejas y remates.

Por dentro incorpora SC Black EVA de densidad 15, una goma que acompaña muy bien al carbono 12K. El resultado es un tacto equilibrado, con buena salida de bola cuando jugamos a menor velocidad y una respuesta más contundente cuando apretamos el golpe..

El acabado Hybrid Spin ayuda a trabajar los efectos en víboras, bandejas y golpes cortados.

También incorpora un mango más largo, un detalle especialmente interesante para jugadores que utilizan el revés a dos manos.
products.englishTitle: Black Crown Hurricane Pro 4.0 - Black Crown
products.englishDescription:
BLACK CROWN HURRICANE PRO 4.0 - The new Hurricane arrives, one of the most desired Black Crown padel rackets each season without a doubt. Version 4.0 signed by Marta Marrero. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The BLACK CROWN HURRICANE PRO 4.0 arrives quite renewed and we find it to be a particularly interesting racket for the advanced player who wants to have a lot of control, but needs the racket to respond when it comes to accelerating. Although it has a round format, this is not a purely defensive racket: it has character, a firm touch and enough power to finish points from the net.

PLAYER TYPE

We recommend this model for experienced high-level players who want a professional racket to perform at their best.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

On the planes we find 12K Power Carbon, which gives it that firm and precise hit that we expect from a high-level racket. When we hit hard, it responds very well and conveys a lot of confidence, something we especially like in volleys, layups and shots.

Inside it incorporates SC Black EVA with a density of 15, a rubber that goes very well with the 12K carbon. The result is a balanced touch, with good ball output when we play at a slower speed and a more forceful response when we press the shot.

The Hybrid Spin finish helps work spin on vipers, layups and slice shots.

It also incorporates a longer handle, a particularly interesting detail for players who use the two-handed backhand.

Las nuevas ASICS SONICSMASH FF WHITE STEEL GREY ya disponibles en Pádel Ibérico. Este modelo mantiene el carácter ágil y dinámico de las Sonicsmash FF, pero en esta ocasión llegan con una combinación en blanco y gris acero mucho más limpia y discreta. Nos parecen unas zapatillas especialmente atractivas para quien busca un modelo moderno que además resulte fácil de combinar.

MYSTICA LEGACY CARBON HYBRID BLUE 2024 - El formato híbrido más completo en una pala. Con refuerzos en el puente con el que se consigue una mejor estabilidad y se reducen vibraciones.

 INTRODUCCIÓN DE LA PALA

Mystica, es una marca de origen español, la cual intenta acercarse a todo tipo de públicos, de ahí su insistencia en traernos versiones tanto de control, potencia o en este caso una versión híbrida. Este modelo es muy manejable, siendo efectiva en golpes defensivos u ofensivos.

Es una pala con balance intermedio, que permite muy buena manejabilidad.

En la pista, la MYSTICA LEGACY CARBON HYBRID BLUE 2024 es una pala de una calidad increíble. Es difícil que no te guste. El tacto es intermedio, y la salida de bola es muy alta. products.title: Black Crown Special Master - Black Crown
products.description:
BLACK CROWN SPECIAL MASTER - Gama alta, con un gran control y tacto muy agradable.

 INTRODUCCIÓN DE LA PALA

La BLACK CROWN SPECIAL MASTER siendo una pala muy polivalente, se nos presenta como una de las que más control nos va a aportar a nuestro juego.

TIPO DE JUGADOR

Para jugadores que busquen un plus en golpes de calidad, un magnifico manejo y adaptable desde nivel avanzado.

CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA PALA

Empezando por su formato, la BLACK CROWN SPECIAL MASTER es una pala con un formato lágrima, en búsqueda siempre de un muy buen equilibrio y priorizando un poco más el control, con una distribución de 60% control y 40% potencia.

Presenta unas caras en carbono 12K que aseguran una respuesta con mucha resistencia, combinadas con un núcleo con goma SSB Black Eva, que se trata de una goma blanda muy agradable, siendo este modelo, la Black Crown con un tacto más blando en este 2024. También presenta una rugosidad tipo arena, consiguiendo así una gran facilidad para conseguir golpes con efecto.

En cuanto a los marcos, tienen un doble tubular en carbono, haciéndola muy resistente y estable.

Además, con la tecnología Extended Sweet Spot Area, vamos a tener un punto dulce ampliado para tener una mayor superficie de golpeo y centrar mejor la bola.

ESTILO DE JUEGO

El estilo de juego que más casa con esta pala, es en el cual busques mucho control sin dejar pasar desapercibido el ataque, ya que también responde con mucha potencia.
products.englishTitle: Black Crown Special Master - Black Crown
products.englishDescription:
BLACK CROWN SPECIAL MASTER - High-end, with great control and a very pleasant touch.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The BLACK CROWN SPECIAL MASTER, being a very versatile racket, is presented to us as one of the ones that will provide us with the most control in our game.

PLAYER TYPE

For players looking for a plus in quality shots, magnificent handling and adaptable from an advanced level.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

Starting with its format, the BLACK CROWN SPECIAL MASTER is a padel racket with a teardrop format, always seeking a very good balance and prioritizing control a little more, with a distribution of 60% control and 40% power.

It has 12K carbon faces that ensure a very resistant response, combined with a core with SSB Black Eva rubber, which is a very pleasant soft rubber, this model being the Black Crown with a softer feel in 2024. It also has a sand-like roughness, thus making it easy to hit hits with spin.

As for the frames, they have a double carbon tubular, making it very resistant and stable.

In addition, with the Extended Sweet Spot Area technology, we will have an enlarged sweet spot to have a larger hitting surface and better center the ball.

PLAY STYLE

The style of play that best suits this racket is one in which you seek a lot of control without letting the attack go unnoticed, since it also responds with a lot of power.

products.title: Softee Rebounce Red 3k - Softee
products.description:
SOFTEE REBOUNCE RED 3K - Pala de pádel de formato redondo. Un nuevo y peculiar formato da esencia a este modelo que sin duda está destinado al control gracias a su amplio punto dulce. INTRODUCCIÓN DE LA PALA

La SOFTEE REBOUNCE RED 3K es una pala con carácter, no es para cualquiera sino quieres arriesgar con el diseño. Este nuevo modelo de Softee para la temporada 2026 es de lo más interesante gracias a su novedoso formato redondo, con un puente aerodinámico que nos permitirá una movilidad más rápido y mejor durante todo el partido. 

Destacamos su color rojo metalizado.

TIPO DE JUGADOR

Está pensada para jugadores que quieren una pala equilibrada, con buena pegada pero sin perder control. No es una pala radical en un solo aspecto: busca ese punto medio que permite defender con seguridad y acelerar cuando el punto lo pide.

CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA PALA

La SOFTEE REBOUNCE RED 3K su nombre nos deja claro cual es el material principal de la pala, la fibra de carbono 3K. Este material nos aporta una mayor rigidez en los planos, lo que se traduce en una salida de bola más directa y una respuesta firme en golpes ofensivos.

El nuevo puente aeroinámico no es solo un detalle visual. Ayuda a reducir vibraciones y mejora la estabilidad en el golpeo.

Además, la superficie rugosa arena, facilita la generación de efectos, y en parte aumenta el control.
products.englishTitle: Softee Rebounce Red 3k - Softee
products.englishDescription:
SOFTEE REBOUNCE RED 3K - Round format padel racket. A new and peculiar format gives essence to this model that is undoubtedly intended for control thanks to its large sweet spot. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The SOFTEE REBOUNCE RED 3K is a racket with character, it is not for everyone if you do not want to take risks with the design. This new Softee model for the 2026 season is most interesting thanks to its innovative round format, with an aerodynamic bridge that will allow us faster and better mobility throughout the game. 

We highlight its metallic red color.

PLAYER TYPE

It is designed for players who want a balanced padel racket, with good punch but without losing control. It is not a radical padel racket in just one aspect: it looks for that middle point that allows you to defend safely and accelerate when the point demands it.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The SOFTEE REBOUNCE RED 3K, its name makes it clear to us what the main material of the racket is, 3K carbon fiber. This material gives us greater rigidity in the planes, which translates into a more direct ball output and a firm response on offensive shots.

The new aerodynamic bridge is not just a visual detail. Helps reduce vibrations and improves stability when hitting.

In addition, the rough sandy surface facilitates the generation of spin, and partly increases control.

products.title: Head Pro Player Cap - Caps
products.description:
The HEAD PRO PLAYER CAP has a very attractive design with the best materials, marking an elegant style typical of HEAD throughout its padel range.
 The HEAD PRO PLAYER CAP is released in 4 colors, black, white, navy blue and turquoise. In both light and dark colors it has a sober appearance and with a detail near the brand's visor that does not stand out too much.

Regarding its composition we can see a visor of adequate length to protect from the discomfort of the sun while playing outdoors. Inside we see a padded area in the forehead area to significantly reduce the amount of sweat that can reach our eyes. Finally, we find an adjustment with velcro and a gap for greater breathing and placement of the ponytail if necessary.

products.title: Enebe Suburban Green 12k 2026 - Enebe
products.description:
ENEBE SUBURBAN GREEN 12K 2026 - La pala más radical, con diseño en formato diamante, con un balance medio ideal para conseguir tanto potencia como equilibrio en el juego. INTRODUCCIÓN DE LA PALA

La ENEBE SUBURBAN GREEN 12K 2026, para los amantes de un diseño agresivo y de la fibra de carbono 12K. es una pala pensada para jugadores que buscan un rendimiento sólido en cada punto. 

TIPO DE JUGADOR

Pala ofensiva, combinando potencia ofensiva y control fiable. Para jugadores de alto nivel.

CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA PALA

La ENEBE SUBURBAN GREEN 12K 2026 Gracias a su forma diamante y balance orientado al ataque, permite imprimir fuerza en cada remate sin renunciar al control necesario en las transiciones defensivas.

Compuesta con fibra de carbono 12K, uno de los materiales más amado por los jugadores profesionales debido a su perfecto equilibrio entre potencia, rigidez y durabilidad. Cuenta también con un Núcleo EVA de tacto medio-blando, que combina suavidad en el golpeo con una buena respuesta, ideal para un juego mixto.

El diseño verde metálico aporta un toque moderno y agresivo, con personalidad propia en la pista.
products.englishTitle: Enebe Suburban Green 12k 2026 - Enebe
products.englishDescription:
ENEBE SUBURBAN GREEN 12K 2026 - The most radical racket, with a diamond format design, with an ideal medium balance to achieve both power and balance in the game. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The ENEBE SUBURBAN GREEN 12K 2026, for lovers of an aggressive design and 12K carbon fiber. It is a padel racket designed for players looking for solid performance in each point. 

PLAYER TYPE

Offensive shovel, combining offensive power and reliable control. For high level players.

The ENEBE SUBURBAN GREEN 12K 2026 Thanks to its diamond shape and attack-oriented balance, it allows you to add strength to each shot without giving up the control necessary in defensive transitions.

The metallic green design provides a modern and aggressive touch, with its own personality on the court.
